name: Safari 27 MCP
tagline: Drives Safari's WebDriver interface to smoke-test online storefronts
description: A QA specialist for online storefronts, built on Safari's WebDriver tooling over its MCP interface. It runs accessibility-tree smoke tests, confirms page structure stays readable to automated agents, and checks behaviour before a DNS change lands. A weekly loop keeps the suite current, with evidence required each run.
author: PixelRainbowNFT
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
